question: Which was Lewis Hamilton first race? What was his points recorded for his first race event?
evidence: first race refers to min(Year); Lewis Hamiltonrefers to the full name of the driver; Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname;
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1 FROM (SELECT T1.name AS c0, T2.points AS c1, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.year ASC) AS __r FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton') AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T1.name, T2.points FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY T1.year ASC LIMIT 1

d.request: Which races did Lewis Hamilton compete in during his earliest recorded year, and how many points did he score in each? Return all rows tied for that earliest year.
d.sql: SELECT ra.name AS race, ra.year, re.points FROM results AS re JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = re.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year = (SELECT MIN(r2.year) FROM results AS re2 JOIN races AS r2 ON r2.raceId = re2.raceId WHERE re2.driverId = d.driverId) ORDER BY ra.round, ra.raceId

c.sql: WITH hamilton_races AS (SELECT ra.name AS race_name, ra.year, ra.round, res.points FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton') SELECT race_name, points FROM hamilton_races WHERE year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM hamilton_races) AND round = (SELECT MIN(round) FROM hamilton_races WHERE year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM hamilton_races));

b.request: Return every race in the earliest year for which Lewis Hamilton (`drivers.forename = 'Lewis'` and `drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'`) has a result, along with his points from `results.points` for each race
b.sql: WITH hamilton AS (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton'), first_year AS (SELECT MIN(ra.year) AS year FROM results re JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = re.raceId WHERE re.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM hamilton)) SELECT ra.raceId, ra.name, ra.date, re.points FROM races ra JOIN first_year fy ON ra.year = fy.year LEFT JOIN results re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId AND re.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM hamilton) ORDER BY ra.round
